We are US-based and care about latency in east/central US regions. I can loop in Tom (procurement) if needed. Attaching our procurement template.

Thanks for the ping — here's a concise pilot offer we can send to HealthMetrics. I kept it procurement-friendly (separate input/output lines) and included a short note on scale pricing.

Proposed pilot pricing (hosted API, US region) — per 1M tokens:
- Tier A (small, latency-optimized — "redwood-lite"): Input $0.60 / 1M | Output $1.00 / 1M
- Tier B (general-purpose — "redwood-core"): Input $0.95 / 1M | Output $1.80 / 1M
- Tier C (high-capacity, reasoning — "redwood-pro"): Input $2.50 / 1M | Output $4.75 / 1M

Pilot terms: 6-week pilot, billed monthly. Pilot discount: 10% off list for first two billing cycles.

Scale guidance (if they commit to monthly tiers after pilot):
- 0–10M / mo: list pricing as above
- 10–50M / mo: 12% volume discount off list
- 50M+ / mo: 20% volume discount off list + optional dedicated capacity conversation

Other notes:
- Include per-route logging and token breakdown by default; extra observability retention is add-on.
- Data handling: US-region private tenancy available for enterprise — standard hosted offering keeps data in US by default.

I attached the current rate card file (redwood_rate_card_v3.xlsx) so procurement has a downloadable sheet. Approve and I'll send to Cara and Tom with a short cover note.

— Marissa Cole
